messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON notifies the MPOO about equipment change intentions. The MPOO announces self dismounting to the MPON or the MPOO shall notify the MPON about no self-dismounting of the MPOO. The MPON or the MPOO perform the final reading. The MPON or the MPOO dismount the old equipment. The MPON mounts the new device. The MPON reads the meter count from the installed meter. The MPON sents the values of the final reading to the GO. The MPON tells the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation. The GO shall notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting, and the meter count at installation.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="EquipmentChangeProcess" name="Equipment Change Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_NotifyIntentions" />
    
    <!-- Step 1: The MPON notifies the MPOO about equipment change intentions. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyIntentions" name="MPON notifies MPOO about equipment change intentions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyIntentions" targetRef="Gateway_DismountDecision" />

    <!-- Step 2: The MPOO announces self dismounting to the MPON or the MPOO shall notify the MPON about no self-dismounting of the MPOO. -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DismountDecision" name="Dismount Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfDismount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoSelfDismount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfDismount" name="Self Dismounting" sourceRef="Gateway_DismountDecision" targetRef="Task_MPOOAnnounceSelfDismount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selfDismount == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSelfDismount" name="No Self Dismounting" sourceRef="Gateway_DismountDecision" targetRef="Task_MPOONotifyNoSelfDismount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selfDismount == false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOOAnnounceSelfDismount" name="MPOO announces self dismounting to MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfDismount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalReading</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOONotifyNoSelfDismount" name="MPOO notifies MPON about no self-dismounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoSelfDismount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalReading</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFinalReading" sourceRef="Task_MPOOAnnounceSelfDismount" targetRef="Task_FinalReading" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromNoSelfToFinal" sourceRef="Task_MPOONotifyNoSelfDismount" targetRef="Task_FinalReading" />

    <!-- Step 3: The MPON or the MPOO perform the final reading. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalReading" name="Perform final reading (MPON or MPOO)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToFinalReading</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromNoSelfToFinal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDismountOld</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDismountOld" sourceRef="Task_FinalReading" targetRef="Task_DismountOldEquipment" />

    <!-- Step 4: The MPON or the MPOO dismount the old equipment. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DismountOldEquipment" name="Dismount old equipment (MPON or MPOO)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDismountOld</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMountNew</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMountNew" sourceRef="Task_DismountOldEquipment" targetRef="Task_MountNewDevice" />

    <!-- Step 5: The MPON mounts the new device. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MountNewDevice" name="MPON mounts the new device">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMountNew</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReadMeter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReadMeter" sourceRef="Task_MountNewDevice" targetRef="Task_ReadMeterCount" />

    <!-- Step 6: The MPON reads the meter count from the installed meter. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadMeterCount" name="MPON reads meter count from installed meter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReadMeter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSendFinalReading</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSendFinalReading" sourceRef="Task_ReadMeterCount" targetRef="Task_SendFinalReadingToGO" />

    <!-- Step 7: The MPON sents the values of the final reading to the GO. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendFinalReadingToGO" name="MPON sends final reading values to GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSendFinalReading</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToNotifyDeviceChanges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToNotifyDeviceChanges" sourceRef="Task_SendFinalReadingToGO" targetRef="Task_NotifyDeviceChangesToGO" />

    <!-- Step 8: The MPON tells the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyDeviceChangesToGO" name="MPON tells GO about device changes, master data, and meter count at installation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToNotifyDeviceChanges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToNotifyMSP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToNotifyMSP" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDeviceChangesToGO" targetRef="Task_GONotifiesMSP" />

    <!-- Step 9: The GO shall notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting, and the meter count at installation. -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GONotifiesMSP" name="GO notifies MSP about device changes, master data, meter count at dismounting, and meter count at installation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToNotifyMSP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_GONotifiesMSP" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
